state.redirect: Instance I stores original application A. A has an immutable recorded merge redirect to active application B. The user interface resolves I by following A to B without changing I. A is retired.
state.physical: An instance stream retains its original application A forever. A user interface displays survivor B by following A's merge redirect. The old implementation contract requires the instance stream to record a move to B.
state.cycle: Application A has a merge redirect to B. B subsequently receives a merge redirect to A. No cycle prevention is enforced.
state.admission: An instance reads target application B as active. B retires. Then the instance commits its move to B. No shared fence or transaction exists.
state.projected: A projection says there are no active instances associated with application A. A previously committed active instance has not yet been processed by the projection.
state.anchor: A published flow version names asset X as its required witness. A separate intended asset Y has not been accepted and is absent from all other authoritative facts shown.
state.links: A flow has a draft. Link X is approved with an encryption waiver valid Monday. On Tuesday the waiver is revoked. On Wednesday a flow version is published after checking only X's earlier approval; no renewed authority or fence exists.
state.single: A published one-asset flow version records exact asset X, source, destination, classification evidence, and protection settings. A separate version is published for asset Y. Each version validates its one asset independently. There is no operation approving both versions together.
state.view: A projection shows a family of flow versions, one per asset, but updates can arrive late. The interface calls the family a complete immutable multi-asset snapshot.
state.group: Ten independent carried-asset decisions each accept or refuse one asset, with no parent retaining their outcomes. A command approves a flow only after enumerating all ten decisions.
state.reclass: A flow was accepted while asset X was internal. Later X is classified restricted. Existing TI-02 records the new classification and displays a current protection gap if encryption is missing.
state.failed: An application retirement records a request. A background read fails or returns an incomplete set. The application is marked retired anyway.

effective_redirect.instructions: In redirect, does the described user interface display B as the effective application for I?

physical_move.instructions: In physical, has the instance stream recorded its required move to B?

redirect_cycle.instructions: In cycle, can following merge redirects return to A indefinitely?

target_race.instructions: In admission, can an instance end up assigned to a retired target?

stale_zero.instructions: In projected, can the zero count omit an active instance?

anchor_all.instructions: In anchor, does naming X prove that intended asset Y was accepted?

old_waiver.instructions: In links, was the waiver still valid when the version was published Wednesday?

single_atomic.instructions: In single, does the design guarantee X and Y become published together atomically?

incomplete_view.instructions: In view, can a late projection omit a published flow version from the displayed family?

approval_scans.instructions: In group, does the approval command depend on every carried-asset decision?

later_gap.instructions: In reclass, does the new classification remain recorded even when the flow has a gap?

failed_retire.instructions: In failed, does the incomplete read prove no active instance remains?
